title: Document Kafka Services, listeners, and StatefulSet
body:
## Goal

Document Kafka Services, listeners, and StatefulSet.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add the headless and broker Services and a single-broker KRaft StatefulSet.
- [ ] Use namespace kafka consistently in selectors, DNS addresses, voter configuration, and storage references.
- [ ] Explain the three listeners, NodePort 30092 to port 9094, and the internal NodePort if retained.
- [ ] Use 50Gi storage and leave JVM memory headroom.
- [ ] Explain cluster-ID preparation, node addressing, and fresh-install deployment order.
- [ ] Check the manifests and complete section review.

## Completion workflow

Complete a small section and pause for review. Commit with a reference to this issue. Close as completed only when the acceptance criteria are met, recording the commit and validation evidence or publication URL.

title: Write troubleshooting from the recorded deployment experience
body:
## Goal

Write troubleshooting from the recorded deployment experience.
